icl_keep_true_all36_query80_ctx20_annota.description: LeRobot ICL keep-true split using all 36 tasks and all available episodes, with continuous per-frame annotations clamped to [0, 100] and mapped to [-1, 0]. Within every task, floor(80%) of episodes are training queries and the remainder are context; there is no test or held-out task split.
